Description
Condition: SEE DESCRIPTION
The MEP-807A is a military tactical quiet diesel generator delivering 100 kW of 60 Hz power (or 83.3 kW at 50 Hz). It features a 66-gallon fuel tank, uses a Caterpillar 3126B diesel engine, measures 106x40x65 inches, and has a dry weight of approximately 5,500 pounds. 
 
Power and Performance
  • Power Output: 100 kW (60 Hz) / 83.3 kW (50 Hz) at 0.8 power factor.
  • Voltage Configurations: Selectable 3-phase, 4-wire outputs including 120/208V or 240/416V.
  • Engine: Caterpillar 3126B 4-cycle, 6-cylinder, 7.25-liter liquid-cooled diesel engine.
  • Fuel Compatibility: Diesel (DL-1, DL-2) and military tactical fuels like JP-8 or F-24. 
Physical and Environmental Specs
  • Dimensions: 106 inches long by 40 inches wide by 65 inches high.
  • Weight: ~5,500 lbs (dry weight).
  • Fuel Capacity: 66 gallons.
  • Sound Level: Approximately 68–70 dBA measured at 7 meters (23 feet).
  • Operating Temperature: Rated for extreme environments ranging from -25°F to +120°F. 
 
This item is missing parts. Motor appears to be in good condition, but without batteries and other missing parts we are unable to test the engine. Motor spins free

WINNING BIDDERS

1.  Pick-ups MUST be scheduled during hours of operation.

2.  Non-operational vehicles must be towed.  No maintenance whatsoever will be allowed on City property other than installation of a new battery.
  
3.  Must have proper equipment to remove vehicle as quickly as possible.  If the equipment is insufficient, you will be turned away and rescheduled for another time.

4.  We do not provide temporary tags for auctioned vehicles, recommend applying for a Vehicle Transit Permit from the Texas DOT.

5.  Vehicles will be titled ONLY to the WINNING BIDDER or BIDDER'S BUSINESS - NO EXCEPTIONS.

6. If someone other than the bidder is picking up a vehicle or piece of equipment, please email a letter of authorization to Chief Shawn Murry at trouppdsmurry@trouptx.com. Email must include the third party's name, auction number, and auction item information. Please include a copy of YOUR (winning bidder) driver's license in the email.  We WILL NOT release anything until we receive this information. 
  
7.  Please do not email an authorization until you contact the office staff.  Also, please confirm that we've received the fax/email.
